stories.summary: An alleged affair involving Nvidia chief Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy has put the company's China strategy under scrutiny. TechCrunch says the allegation could complicate Nvidia's lobbying to loosen US chip-export restrictions while preserving access to China's AI market.

stories.title: ‘Thicky thicky dumb dumb’ satirist Cody Dahler on his viral videos: ‘my material is presented to me on a silver platter!’
stories.summary: Writer and podcaster Cody Dahler discusses his viral satirical videos and his effort to make world events easier for a broad audience to understand. He says politics is often made to seem more complicated than it is and traces his interest in comedy to childhood encouragement to perform.

stories.title: Freed Israeli Hostages Still Had Shrapnel in Their Bodies From Oct. 7 Attack
stories.summary: Some freed Israeli hostages still had shrapnel in their bodies from the October 7 attack, according to an Israeli medical official. The official said some of the women were held alone for extended periods and spent eight months in tunnels.
